evidence_slice: Rother District Council's Regulation 18 Rother Local Plan 2025-2042 identifies Policy WS4, Land on east side of Cottage Lane, Westfield, as a proposed residential allocation for some 20 dwellings on a 1.19 ha greenfield site; outline permission RR/2022/1118/P was granted 2025-06-27, while an appealed Forestry Commission Restocking Notice remains pending and, if upheld, the site would not be allocated in the final Plan.
